DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_SnowPeafowl:
So precise is its sense of time that 
it awakens at the exact same hour every morning.
According to Palpagos lore, a day was divided into 24 parts because
when <characterName id=|SnowPeafowl|/> spreads its tail feathers wide,
it reveals a pattern with 24 distinct spaces.

Lays <itemName id=|Egg| style=|Status_Keyword|/>'s when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_SnowPeafowl:
While in party, 
<characterName id=|SnowPeafowl|/>'s icy aura sharpens focus, increasing the player's <Status_Keyword>reload speeds</> by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

Lays <itemName id=|Egg| style=|Status_Keyword|/>'s when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
